full_judgment:
Mr. Mohammad Fazlul Karim, J:- This petition for Leave to Appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 27.04.2006 passed by the High Court Division in Writ Petition No.8891 of 2005 making the Rule absolute releasing the house bearing Holding No.6 and 6A, Anada Chandra Roy Road on S.A. Plot NO.2858 of mouza Dhaka, present mouza namely Lalbagh, 12177, 12178 and 12179, D.P. Khatian (Field Parcha) No.3757 D.P. and D.P. Dag No.12831, 12832, 12833, 12834, 12835, 12836 and 12837 under P.S. Kotwali, present P.S. Lalbagh in the City of Dhaka from the list of vested property which was included by the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue), Dhaka and as such, listing the property on 05.03.1997 as illegal, without any lawful authority and directing to restore vacant possession thereof to the writ petition within 30 days from the date of receipt of the copy of the judgment. 

 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the writ-petitioner, Dhaka Memos Anjuman, is a charitable organization and run for charitable purposes including making provision for education and financial assistance to the poor. The writ-petitioner purchased the case land including buildings thereon by a registered deed dated 05.121962 from Kazi Paziruddin Ahmed and others who became owners of the case property through a registered exchange deed dated 06.04.1962 from Chinmoyee Debi and Shanti Bhusan Banarjee. The .Additional Deputy Commissioner (Revenue) gave permission for the said exchange deed vide Misc. Case No.58 of 1961-62, the photocopy of both the deeds have been marked as Annexure-A and A-I Both the C.S. and S.A. Khatians in respect of the case property were duly procured recording in the name of Chinmoyee Debi and Shanti Bhusan Banarjee and after purchase of the case land it was duly prepared and recorded in the name of writ-petitioner in R.S. Khatian. The writ-petitioner on the request of high-ranking police officers allowed for setting up of a temporary police camp in some portion of the house in 1987 in order to maintain peace in the locality. But unfortunately and without any lawful and valid authority the police personnel started living therein and occupied the house without any agreement with the writ-petitioner. Thereafter, the President and Secretary of the Dhaka Memon Anjuman executed a general power of attorney on 20.04.2004 appointing Khawaja Mohammad Akbar to do all acts on behalf of the writ-petitioner which is marked as Annexure-E to the writ-petition. The said attorney by a prayer in writing dated 22.02.2003 requested the Secretary, Ministry of Home Affairs and Inspector General of Police for restoration of vacant possession of the house by removing police personnel living therein. Consequently, upon the said prayer, the Deputy Commissioner of Police, Dhaka Vs. Dhaka Memon Aniurnan 20BLT(AD) 2012 (South) directed the officer-in-charge, Police Station Kotwah, DMP, to make an enquiry into the matter and after due enquiry he submitted detailed report on 12.06.2004 stating that the writ-petitioner is the owner and possessor of the case property but several police personnel are staying therein without authority, therefore, steps should be taken for their eviction and restoration of possession in favour of the writ-petitioner. That the building of the writ-petitioner is very old and likely to collapse at any moment, moreover, at present there is no justification for' their stay in that house. Inspite of such report the police authority did not take step for eviction of those illegal occupants. Ministry of Home Affairs, consequently through one Deputy Police Commissioner made another enquiry into the matter and submitted a report stating that illegal occupant police personnel should be evicted therefrom and its vacant possession to be handed over to the writ-petitioner which are marked as Annexure-F and F-1, to the writ-petition. 

 6. It appears from the- record that Chinmoyee and Shanti Bhusan 'obtained permission from proper authority for exchange of the case land with on Kazi Faziruddin on 06.04.1962 and that Paziruddin and other who subsequently sold the same to the writ-petitioner on 05.12.1962. It also appears from the record that both the C.S. and S.A. Khatians were duly recorded in the names of Chinmoyee .and Shanti Bhusan Banarjee and R.S. Khatian was also duly recorded in the name of the writ-petitioner. It also revealed from Annexures-F, F-1, H, H-1 that the writ-petitioner filed several applications to the Secretary of the concerned Ministry and Inspector General of Police and consequent upon the said prayers, police officers made enquiry into the matter and submitted report stating that the writ-petitioner is the owner of the case property and the illegal occupant police personnel should be evicted but the writ-respondents have not yet taken any step pursuant to those enquiry reports. It appears from the list of vested property of Kowati Police Station, Dhaka (Annexure-G) that the property in question was not included in the list as vested property.
